Two small things for the next edit, neither blocking:
  > 1. M3 decides H1 by 'the paired difference between the aggregate-high cells' decision-level share and 1'. A share is below 1 whenever one instance fails, so that test is nearly empty. Fix: state the H1 gap as a per-cell contrast, for example the mean per-instance Pearson (≥ 0.9) against the share with P_c^ε ≥ 0.9, with a bootstrap CI over instances. Then say how large the gap must be to count as 'lower'. Fix that size now, for example 10 points, before any result.
  > 2. The page header says 'Brief rev 3'. The Brief is at rev 4, which corrected H3 (error ∝ σ/√m, budget ∝ σ²/g²). M5 already matches rev 4, so only the pointer is stale.

Main text 9 pages including figures and tables; references, appendix and checklist do not count; 16-item checklist mandatory; no limit on the number of figures/tables, only on pages. Accepted-paper sample (13 papers, hand-picked, not random): median 5 figures+tables in the body, max 9; abstract median 171 words; intro ~700 words. Your rev-2 body (Fig 1–5, Tables 1–3, Fig 6 panel = 8–9 items) is at the top of that range; planning estimate leaves ~4.5–5 pages of text. Keep your cut order; decide it from the paper-repo document build's page count. Also: the headline's scope (B=50 random rows) should be stated in the body/abstract, because the venue wants evaluation-critical material in the body, not the appendix. Declare contribution type General (not Negative Results). No action needed beyond reading VENUE.md §6.
